title: Louisiana Starlink adoption hold: 10,635 planned locations remain a forward cohort
publisher: Louisiana Office of Broadband Development and Connectivity
summary: Louisiana's agreement identifies 10,635 planned locations and an end-of-summer availability target, but no activated, installed, subscribed, tested, retained, priced, complained, or accepted-closeout results are public.
